finding.description: The image within the framed picture on the right wall shifts and changes shape, appearing to move, as the woman's shadow passes over it.
As the woman walks back toward the kitchen, the framed picture visible through the doorway morphs significantly; the image becomes abstract and unrecognizable, and the frame distorts.
A large blue dangle earring is visible on her left ear when she turns her head, which was not present in the earlier profile view.
The dress suddenly features gathered, slightly puffed seams on the shoulders, and her hair appears noticeably curlier and shorter.
The gathered seams on the dress shoulders disappear between cuts, reverting to smooth shoulders.
A distinct V-shaped seam or yoke appears on the upper back of the dress.
The seam detail on the upper back of the dress changes from V-shaped to a straight horizontal line.

When the subject first walks down the hallway, the blue flower picture is on the wall to her right. When she turns around and walks back, the picture is still on her right, meaning it has inexplicably moved to the opposite wall.
A red kettle appears on the stove as the subject returns to the kitchen. It was not present on the stove when she initially walked past it at the beginning of the video.
The microwave was originally resting on the right-hand kitchen counter. When the subject returns to the kitchen, the microwave is now mounted on the wall above the stove on the left side.

When the woman turns around to exit the bedroom, the hallway she originally walked through has disappeared. The bedroom doorway now opens directly into the kitchen, which has also been repositioned. The spatial relationship between the rooms is completely altered.
The framed picture of the blue flower, initially seen on the wall between the kitchen and the hallway, is now located on the wall to the left of the bedroom doorway as she exits.

verdicts.reason: The image within the frame does not morph or change shape; it simply darkens as the woman's shadow passes over it.
verdicts.innocent_explanation: a reflection on glass, a window, or a screen behaving like reflections do

verdicts.reason: The picture in the background doorway does not morph significantly; it is just out of focus due to depth of field and motion blur.
verdicts.innocent_explanation: motion blur or compression smear (not morphing, duplication, or vanishing)
